scope: Native Edge download and localStorage; synthetic page/records; nonpersistent isolated context; all network intercepted

checks.case: valid records downloaded; exact raw strings preserved; unrelated storage excluded; zero storage mutation
damaged records downloaded; exact raw strings preserved; unrelated storage excluded; zero storage mutation
empty storage creates no download; status and button recover

limitations: Synthetic page, not full product end-to-end
Export is not import/restore validation or transactional snapshot
Browser access denial/download blocking only covered by synthetic unit tests
